title: FrootAI Policy Overlay (V7)
description: Company-owned policy.yaml/policy.json schema for the V7 Policy Overlay Engine. The 13 overlay domains (regions, models, skus, naming, tags, network, rbac, identity, iac, encryption, observability, cost, custom_checks) compose across resolver -> composer -> emitter pipelines. Every overlay is OPTIONAL — an absent domain contributes no overlay for that slice; an empty array means 'no constraint' (NOT 'reject everything'). NEVER FAKE A SIGNAL §0.5 #4: the schema only describes shape; semantic enforcement lives in the V7.4-V7.18 overlay functions and surfaces typed PolicyError on conflict.

spec_version.description: Policy spec version. Bump only when this schema changes shape (the V7.30 close pins v1; v2 is a breaking-change event).

company.description: Free-form company/org identifier surfaced in PolicyDiff + telemetry.

regions.description: Allowed Azure region names (e.g. ['eastus', 'westeurope']). Resolver candidates that don't support every listed region are filtered out (V7.6). Empty array = no region constraint.

models.description: Model allowlist/denylist for Cognitive Services / OpenAI deployments (V7.7).

allow.description: Whitelisted model ids (e.g. ['gpt-4o', 'gpt-4o-mini']). Empty array = no constraint.

deny.description: Blacklisted model ids. Overrides allow on conflict.

skus.description: SKU allowlist/denylist applied across every emitted resource (V7.8).

naming.description: Naming convention overlay (V7.9). Rewrites canonical resource names to satisfy company-pinned prefix/suffix/separator/max_length.

tags.description: Tag overlay (V7.10): inject required tag keys + validate values against regex patterns.

required.description: Tag keys that MUST be present on every taggable resource.

additionalProperties.description: Regex pattern the tag value must match.

values.description: Map of tag-key -> regex pattern for value validation.

network.description: Network overlay (V7.11). posture=private triggers PE module + DNS-zone wiring injection.

dns_zone_overrides.description: Resource-type -> DNS zone name override map (e.g. 'Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts' -> 'privatelink.blob.core.windows.net').

rbac.description: RBAC overlay (V7.12). managed_identity_required=true enforces composer MI wiring + rejects service-principal alternatives.

role_assignment_policy.description: strict=only built-in roles; permissive=custom roles allowed if scoped; any=no constraint.

identity.description: Identity overlay (V7.13). Filters Entra ID provider config + enforces guest-account policy.

iac.description: IaC format overlay (V7.14). Dispatches V5 Bicep emitter / V6 Terraform emitter / both; toggles modular emit (V5.21 + V6 parallel).

modular_emit.description: When true, emit per-category split files (V5.21 + V6 parallel).

gold_allowed.description: When false, only AVM-verified modules are emitted; community modules rejected at resolver.

encryption.description: Encryption overlay (V7.15). cmk_required=true injects customer-managed-key references on every supported resource.

observability.description: Observability overlay (V7.16). Enforces Log Analytics + App Insights wiring when *_required=true.

cost.description: Cost overlay (V7.17). band_target rejects SKUs above the band; tier_default injects default tier when caller omits.

custom_checks.description: User-defined checks evaluated against the composed AST (V7.18). Each carries a CUSTOM-<bucket>-NNN id mirroring the V1.22 sealed-namespace convention.

id.description: CUSTOM-<bucket>-NNN. Same shape as V1.22 sealed-namespace; never collides with WAF-*/CAF-*.

expression.description: Match expression evaluated against the composed AST. V7.18 owns the evaluator + the expression DSL.
